episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Kim Jiyong loses his mother to a gangster and begins punishing criminals who evade the law.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Choi Miryeo baits the Vigilante with more information on the criminals on REPO25h.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Copycat crimes emerge nationwide, and Jo Heon and Choi Miryeo chase after the Vigilante.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The fake Vigilante suggests joining forces; Jo Heon closes in on the Vigilante's identity.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Miryeo reports on Sewool's alleged crimes; Kim Jiyong and Jo Heon come into conflict.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jiyong and Gangok help Miryeo continue digging into Kim Samdoo and the Vole.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: The Vole tries to bury the case by sacrificing Kim Sam-doo, but Sam-doo retaliates with all he has.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Kim Ji-yong gathers everyone involved in one location, and the final battle begins.
